body: OWNER RECOMMENDATION, relayed without appointment authority: a deputy would materially help. The owner recommends codex-cli-vertical-slice as operations deputy because it is active, currently unencumbered, has no unread queue, and is already helping with board hygiene. Chief retains the decision and should record the exact role, powers, limits, and relationship to single-accountable-chief governance before any reassignment or authority transfer. Recall-collab has made no appointment, assignment, reservation, or permission change.
